reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: The durable runner offers routes a release callback that renames the running command http.follow/v1 (as the follows-turn header does); a non-streamed chat calls it once its turn is saved and started (harness after start_chat_turn, provider before capacity admission), so it no longer holds the project's work lane while it waits. Selected: durable delivery (new release regression), runtime coordination, execution worker lane consumers, chat acceptance and diagnostic boundaries; SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: the caller gets the same response. The project-level effect was measured on a fake scratch Core with a fake Codex app-server and a trickling provider stub.
